labels:
Require phone number on all lead capture forms

When enabled, leads must provide a phone number to submit any lead capture form.

Require CAPTCHA on all lead capture forms

When enabled, a CAPTCHA challenge will be added to all lead capture forms, asking website visitors to complete a simple challenge to verify they are human and help reduce spam.

Show Agent Selector on all lead capture forms

When enabled, website visitors can choose a specific agent to contact on capture forms. When disabled, leads are assigned according to your existing lead routing rules.
